hypotheses.title: Storage Array Edited with Memory

hypotheses.title: Unsafe Casting of integers
hypotheses.description: Downcasting int/uints in Solidity can be unsafe due to the potential for data loss and unintended behavior.When downcasting a larger integer type to a smaller one (e.g., uint256 to uint128), the value may exceed the range of the target type,leading to truncation and loss of significant digits. Use OpenZeppelin's SafeCast library to safely downcast integers. Instances: contracts/partners/tokenWrappers/PufferPointTokenWrapper.sol:113, contracts/partners/tokenWrappers/SonicFragment.sol:45, contracts/partners/tokenWrappers/SonicFragment.sol:63

hypotheses.title: Costly operations inside loop

hypotheses.title: PUSH0 Opcode
hypotheses.description: Solc compiler version 0.8.20 switches the default target EVM version to Shanghai, which means that the generated bytecode will include PUSH0 opcodes. Be sure to select the appropriate EVM version in case you intend to deploy on a chain other than mainnet like L2 chains that may not support PUSH0, otherwise deployment of your contracts will fail. Instances: contracts/AccessControlManager.sol:3, contracts/Disputer.sol:3, contracts/DistributionCreator.sol:3

hypotheses.title: Loop Contains `require`/`revert`
hypotheses.description: Avoid `require` / `revert` statements in a loop because a single bad item can cause the whole transaction to fail. It's better to forgive on fail and return failed elements post processing of the loop Instances: contracts/DistributionCreator.sol:212, contracts/DistributionCreator.sol:425, contracts/Distributor.sol:443

hypotheses.title: State Change Without Event

hypotheses.title: Address State Variable Set Without Checks
